Customer Success Executive (Full-Time)

About the Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Executive (CSE) to support our customers and ensure smooth coordination across projects. This is a full-time remote role (Singapore hours, 9:30 AM 6:30 PM SGT, Monday to Friday).

You will handle customer enquiries, assist with quotations, and coordinate with internal teams. Beyond daily support, this role offers the opportunity to work with generative AI tools (including our Superbench platform, which automates ~60% of customer queries) and progressively grow into account management.

Core Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly to customer enquiries across WhatsApp, email, calls, and social media messages.
  • Manage appointment scheduling, reminders, and follow-ups.
  • Prepare and send quotations.
  • Coordinate with external vendors (e.g., makeup artists) and internal team members to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Provide general administrative support, including documentation, assisting with reporting, and supporting team members in day-to-day operations.
  • Growth Responsibilities (progressive with training)
  • Supervise and train the Superbench AI platform to improve accuracy and automation.
  • Track customer interactions and update records in CRM tools.
  • Monitor lead conversions (e.g., from social media enquiry to confirmed booking).
  • Assist with collecting client feedback and preparing simple reports.
  • Support continuous process improvements to enhance customer experience.

What Were Looking For

  • Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken).
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities.
  • Customer-first mindset with a solution-oriented approach.
  • Open to learning and applying AI-driven tools in daily work.
  • Growth mindset with ambition to develop into account management.
  • Diploma or Degree preferred, but not required if you have relevant experience.
  • Minimum 1 year of relevant experience, ideally 2-3 years, in customer service, social media engagement, or client coordination.
  • Familiarity with creative industries (photography, videography, events) is a plus.

Working Hours

  • Monday to Friday
  • 9:30 AM 6:30 PM (Singapore time)
  • 1-hour lunch break

Requirements

  • A reliable laptop with stable internet connection.
  • A spare mobile phone (business number will be provided).
  • Openness to learning and incorporating AI technology into daily work.

Career Progression

This role is structured as a growth pathway. With strong performance, the CSE can progress into an Account Executive or Account Manager role within 2 years, taking on greater responsibility in client servicing and project management.

At Nordzero we develop and sell products that help boost mood, well-being, beauty, and life quality every day. We want to create long-term added value for society. To ensure that our measures are effective, we set ourselves ambitious targets and measure our success. We actively strive to be more sustainable with all of our brands and products.

  • Project management to ensure smooth operations.

  • Conducting keyword research and analysis.
  • Copywriting for product listings.

  • Troubleshooting and resolving listing issues.

  • Establishing and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Collaborating with operations and customer support teams to ensure seamless business operations and customer satisfaction.
  • Prepare regular performance reports, highlighting key metrics, campaign results, and recommendations for further optimization.

Our benefits:

  • Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company.
  • Competitive salary and bonus opportunities.
  • Supportive work environment.
  • Friendly International start-up environment.
  • Paid trainings and courses.

raw.description:
Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Location: Remote — we hire across multiple jurisdictions

Hours: US Eastern Time

Our Firm

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters. Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

We are remote-first, and our support teams work as one global Legal Operations function across multiple time zones.

Learn more at www.sterlingtonlaw.com

The Opportunity

We are looking for a first-class Legal Practice Assistant to provide white glove support service to our firm’s partners and attorneys. By gaining a deep understanding of each partner’s practice, you will support them to execute on client matters, run the administrative engine behind the work, coordinate with stakeholders across the firm, and help ensure our business and our clients’ goals are achieved.

We are looking for someone who is curious and practical in using AI and technology to improve day-to-day work, streamline processes and support attorneys more efficiently.

This is a broad role for someone who wants more than calendar management. Alongside core executive support, you will work on documents, matter coordination, process and project management. As we scale, we are adding elite talent to this team.

What You’ll Do

  • The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. Inboxes with judgment, not just volume: triage, surface, draft the first pass, chase what has gone quiet. Meeting packs, briefing notes, agendas, and the follow-up actions afterwards. Travel end to end, including the changes in flight and the reconciliation afterwards.
  • The client-facing paperwork. Engagement letters prepared, circulated and tracked through to signature and return. Client and prospect correspondence written to a standard that reflects who we act for. Contact records and CRM entries that are accurate because you keep them that way.
  • The documents.Formatting, versioning, comparison, and preparing the execution copy to firm standard. Filing that means anyone can find the document, not just you.
  • Time and billing, to the flagging line. Prompting and chasing time capture. Flagging billable items, disbursements and expenses to Finance for processing. You need enough billing literacy to spot what matters. You will not be processing it.
  • How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.
  • Fluent English, verbal and written
  • Strong proficiency with MS Office, Aderant or similar practice management software, PowerBI or similar data analytics dashboards, Claude, CoPilot or similar AI tools, Asana or similar project management tools
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills; able to carry several workstreams without dropping detail
  • Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively
  • Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration
  • Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system — or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Position Overview:

We’re looking for a highly motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) to own outbound prospecting and pipeline generation across Latin America (LATAM)). Your mission is to identify, engage, and qualify new business opportunities in the HRTech space, helping build a strong foundation for revenue growth.
This role is 100% outbound-driven and ideal for someone who enjoys creating opportunities from scratch, moving quickly, and adapting messaging across diverse markets. You’ll play a key role in opening conversations, validating market opportunities, and creating qualified pipeline for the sales team.

  • Identify, research, and prioritize target accounts across LATAM markets.

  • Adapt messaging and outreach strategies to different countries, industries, and buyer behaviors across the region.
  • Test, iterate, and optimize outbound sequences to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Marketing to ensure smooth pipeline progression.
  • Identify emerging market trends, customer pain points, and competitive insights.

Requirements:

  • 1+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, or outbound prospecting.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage decision-makers.
  • Ability to manage high outreach volumes while maintaining quality.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and sales engagement tools.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving and evolving environments.
  • Fluent English (C2 or equivalent); Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

About YOU:

You’re proactive, resilient, and energized by creating opportunities where none exist. You enjoy experimentation, move with urgency, and know how to tailor your approach across different customer profiles. You thrive in ambiguity and are motivated by measurable impact and growth.

About the Role

Remote People is looking for a Senior HR Compliance & Escalations Specialist to join our EMEA Support team.

This is a senior, employee- and client-facing HR Operations role for someone who enjoys solving complex employment challenges, not simply routing questions to other teams. You will be the escalation point for high-priority cases that require sound judgement, strong compliance knowledge and calm, clear communication.

You will support a broad range of employee lifecycle matters, including contracts, leave, payroll and benefits queries, employee relations and offboarding. A key part of the role is being able to assess the situation, understand the local employment risk and provide a practical answer or recommendation directly. While you will partner closely with Payroll, Legal, Compliance and local providers when needed, you will take ownership of driving cases through to resolution.

You will also help strengthen the wider Support function by identifying recurring issues, improving processes and creating clear guidance that enables the team to prevent avoidable escalations.

This role is ideal for a hands-on HR Operations professional with strong multi-country EMEA compliance experience, particularly across Spain, France and German, who can confidently de-escalate sensitive employee or client concerns and deliver an excellent support experience in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Job Responsibilities

  • Act as the senior escalation point for complex employee and client HR queries across EMEA, taking ownership from initial assessment through to a clear, compliant resolution.

  • Provide practical, accurate guidance on employment compliance, contracts, leave, benefits, payroll-related queries, employee relations and offboarding.

  • Independently assess risk and resolve high-priority cases wherever possible, reducing unnecessary reliance on external providers or internal specialist teams.

  • Apply strong working knowledge of employment practices across key EMEA countries—particularly Spain, France and Germany—to provide timely, actionable answers.

  • Lead sensitive employee and client conversations by phone or video when written communication is not sufficient, using empathy and sound judgement to de-escalate concerns and restore trust.

  • Work closely with Payroll, Legal, Compliance, Operations and local providers when specialist input is required; provide clear case context, recommendations and next steps to drive resolution efficiently.

  • Manage a varied case queue through tickets and email, prioritising urgent issues and ensuring cases are documented accurately and resolved within agreed service levels.

  • Identify recurring case themes, investigate root causes and create practical SOPs, knowledge-base guidance and process improvements to prevent repeat escalations.

  • Support and coach junior support team members on complex cases, compliance principles and best practices for case ownership and communication.

  • Maintain clear, audit-ready case documentation, including risk considerations, decisions taken, stakeholder input and employee/client communications.

Key Qualifications

  • 5+ years of progressive HR Operations, Employee Relations, EOR, PEO, HR shared services or employment-compliance experience in a multi-country EMEA environment.

  • Strong hands-on knowledge of employment compliance and employee lifecycle processes, with direct experience supporting Spain, France and Germany strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience independently resolving complex escalations involving contracts, leave, payroll, benefits, terminations, employee relations or compliance, not simply routing cases to other teams.

  • Proven ability to de-escalate sensitive employee or client situations through clear, calm and empathetic communication.

  • Experience working in a ticket-based HR support environment and managing case queues, SLAs, quality standards and competing priorities.

  • Ability to assess employment risk, make sound recommendations and recognise when Legal, Payroll or a local provider must be involved.

  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience coordinating effectively with Payroll, Legal, Compliance, Operations, Benefits and external partners.

  • Track record of improving HR processes through root-cause analysis, SOPs, knowledge management or workflow automation.

  • Excellent written and spoken English; additional European languages are a plus.

  • Experience with HRIS and case-management tools such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, Jira, Workday, InterCom or similar.

  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

Position: Care Coordinator
Location: Metro Manila
Work setup & shift: Remote | Day Shift
Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:
  • Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses
  • A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.
  • Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.
  • Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a team that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.
Role Overview:
The Care Coordinator plays a key role in supporting older people receiving Home Care Package and Support at Home services to live safely, independently, and with dignity in their own homes. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality service coordination, including client onboarding, scheduling and rostering, referral management, documentation, and clear, respectful communication with clients, families, and providers. The Care Coordinator ensures that services are organised, goal-aligned, culturally inclusive, and responsive to each client's needs and preferences, while upholding the principles of supported decision-making, wellness, reablement, and dignity of risk
In managing a caseload of clients with low to moderately complex needs, the Care Coordinator also performs key functions such as gathering information for assessments and care plans, identifying early signs of deterioration, supporting risk assessments, coordinating care plan reviews, and monitoring service outcomes to ensure safety and quality. The role promotes trauma-informed, culturally safe practice in all interactions and collaborates closely with the broader team to ensure compliance with organisational policies, WHS requirements, and quality and safety standards. Through these responsibilities, the Care Coordinator contributes to a high-performing, client-centred service model that delivers consistent, safe, and effective Support at Home services

What﻿ You'll Do:

﻿﻿

1. Client Onboarding & Initial Information Gathering
  • Conduct onboarding intake and complete client setup in the care management system.
  • Gather all relevant documentation, including health summaries, hospital discharge notes, allied health recommendations, cultural needs, identity preferences, communication needs, and existing informal/formal supports.
  • Explain the Support at Home program, service list, approved supports, pricing structure, rights, responsibilities, and the client's Support Plan in a clear, trauma-informed manner.
  • Ensure all onboarding interactions reflect:
    • trauma-informed communication
    • culturally safe practice
    • supported decision-making
    • respect for identity, autonomy, and dignity
    • transparent discussion of services and options
  • Identify any risks or early signs of deterioration during onboarding and escalate promptly.
  • Support the client to understand and complete care planning documents
Outcome: Clients feel respected, understood, informed, culturally supported, and emotionally safe from the first point of contact.
2. Supporting Care Planning & Reassessment
  • Gather information for assessments across functional, clinical, social, cultural, environmental, behavioural, and safety domains.
  • Support the development and review of Individualised Support Plans and quarterly budgets, ensuring goals and preferences are documented using supported decision-making principles.
  • Assist clients to understand their plan, budget, approved services, and care options.
  • Coordinate and schedule reassessments when:
    • needs evolve
    • conditions change
    • goals have been met or require updating
    • emerging risks or deterioration is identified
  • Assist in collecting risk information, documenting risk themes, and contributing to risk mitigation strategies under clinical direction.
  • Ensure all plan updates reflect wellness and reablement principles.
3. Monitoring of Wellbeing, Risks & Early Deterioration
  • Conduct monthly client touchpoints early in the care journey and additional monitoring as clinically appropriate.
  • Monitor client wellbeing by communicating with clients, workers, family members, supporters, and providers.
  • Identify early signs of deterioration (physical, cognitive, emotional, social) and escalate promptly.
  • Support updating of risk profiles, safety plans, and care plans following clinical direction.
  • Assist in implementing and tracking risk mitigation strategies over time.
  • Review client notes regularly to identify changing needs or risks.
  • Record incidents and assist with follow-up documentation (not investigation, which is excluded)
4. Coordination of Services, Rostering & Scheduling
  • Coordinating the safe, timely commencement of services following onboarding.
  • Communicating service preferences, cultural needs, worker preferences, and schedule options to the rostering team
  • Communicating with support workers, allied health clinicians, nursing staff, and external providers about client needs and wellbeing.
  • Issuing internal and external referrals in line with SaH rules and client needs.
  • Organising approved aids, equipment, and consumables within SaH/HCP guidelines.
  • Supporting continuity of care and ensuring clients are notified of service changes.
  • Facilitating transitions in/out of hospital, respite, short term restorative care, or other settings and ensuring continuity of care through timely communication and documentation.
5. Client & Family Communication
  • Provide respectful, trauma-informed, culturally safe, and transparent communication with clients and families.
  • Support clients to understand their service options, risks, and preferences using supported decision-making principles.
  • Arrange interpreters, translated materials, and communication aids when required.
  • Assist clients to express feedback
  • Maintain accurate, real-time progress notes and documentation.
Outcome: Clients and families feel heard, supported, informed, and empowered.
6. Monthly Client Touchpoints & Feedback Collection
  • Conduct or coordinate monthly touchpoints during initial engagement or when clinically appropriate thereafter.
  • Collect and document client feedback, themes, issues, preferences, and suggestions.
  • Escalate concerns promptly to senior staff.
  • Identify opportunities to increase wellness- and goal-aligned service utilisation.
7. Budget & Financial Support Activities
  • Monitor client budgets.
  • Identify and flag risks of overspending and support corrective planning.
  • Assist in ordering approved consumables in line with SaH/HCP inclusion rules.
  • Resolve billing questions with the finance team.
  • Identify opportunities to maximise reablement-aligned service delivery within budget.
  • Prepare budget summaries for quarterly review.
8. Quality, Safety, Compliance & Organisational Contribution
  • Maintain accurate, high-quality documentation and ensure digital integrity in our compliance software Visual Care.
  • Promote a safe reporting culture free from fear of retaliation.
  • Support WHS, infection control, safe environment practices, and hazard identification.
  • Participate in quality audits, reviews, incidents follow-up, and improvement activities.
  • Ensure compliance with:
    • Aged Care Act 2024
    • Strengthened Quality Standards
    • Aged Care Code of Conduct
    • Statement of Rights
    • Organisational policies
  • Support improvements in care processes, service delivery, and client experience.
9. Relationship Building & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build trusting, respectful relationships with clients, families, advocates, and supporters.
  • Liaise with external providers to ensure coordinated, high-quality service delivery.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary meetings, internal case discussions, and handovers.
  • Promote Sensible Care services ethically and professionally
What﻿ You'll Do:
Essential
  • Excellent Communication Skills in English (Written and Verbal):
    Ability to communicate effectively and politely with clients, team members, healthcare professionals, and external service providers.
  • Background in healthcare and nursing is highly regarded
  • Sound understanding of community healthcare and/or aged care services
  • Time Management and Planning:
    Strong time management skills to handle multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and manage competing priorities effectively.
  • Interpersonal Skills:
    Ability to develop and maintain positive relationships within the team, with clients, service providers, and other stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail:
    High level of accuracy in documenting client information, service updates, and other essential data in the systems.
  • Computer Proficiency:
    Competence in using general computer applications, with a willingness to learn our care management software package, including Sensible Care's care management software Visual Care.
  • Compliance Requirements:
    The role requires the successful candidate to have or obtain a national police check due to the management nature of the position in the aged care sector.
  • Compliance with Aged Care Act 2024, Code of Conduct, Statement of Rights, and all Sensible Care policies
  • Adherence to WHS and infection control requirements
  • Participation in continuous improvement and training

raw.description:
About Clarity Pediatrics
Clarity Pediatrics is building a new model for pediatric chronic care — one that brings affordable, science-backed care to the 1 in 3 kids with chronic conditions. We deliver virtual, evidence-based care that’s accessible, collaborative, and designed to support families and providers alike. We’ve started with ADHD and anxiety, and we’re working to expand into other chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity. Backed by $10M from leading healthcare investors, we’re led by experienced clinicians and healthcare leaders with deep domain expertise and a shared commitment to clinical excellence.

Our Culture

We’re building a team of clinicians who are collaborative, curious, and committed to delivering exceptional care. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Co-founded by a pediatric provider, with exceptional clinical leaders including licensed mental health providers in key roles shaping every major decision

  • Clinical model built to partner closely with referring providers

  • Multidisciplinary collaboration and robust case consultation opportunities

  • A diverse, inclusive, and mission-driven community where your voice matters

  • Access to expert clinical guidance from ADHD and anxiety specialists and researchers

  • Ongoing opportunities for professional growth and training

What We Offer

We’re committed to taking care of the healthcare providers who care for our patients. Our benefits include:

  • Fully remote and flexible schedule

  • Salary $85,000-$110,000/year (full-time)

  • Available bonus opportunities

  • Medical, dental, vision, and ancillary benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Flexible PTO

  • CME/CEU support and reimbursement

  • Remote-friendly work culture

  • A dedicated care coordination team to support with administrative tasks (e.g., cancellations, rescheduling, documentation requests, billing)

  • And more—we’re growing and evolving, so tell us what matters most to you!

About the Role

Clarity Pediatrics is seeking full time, licensed Child and Family Therapists to join our remote, multidisciplinary team. You’ll provide clinical services including ADHD and anxiety assessments and leading parenting groups such as Parent Training in Behavior Management (BPT) and Supportive Parenting for Anxious Childhood Emotion (SPACE).

We’re committed to setting clinicians up for success with peer consultation groups, guidance from ADHD and anxiety experts, and stipends for professional development. You’ll also have the opportunity to shape our care model and improve workflows that support high-quality, sustainable care. We value diverse clinical backgrounds and encourage you to grow your expertise, lead initiatives, and focus on what you do best.

With our full time (40 hr/week) role, enjoy flexible scheduling within our operating hours (weekdays 8 am – 8 pm and Saturdays), in the time zone where you provide care.

What You’ll Own

  • Conduct comprehensive ADHD and anxiety assessments and intake evaluations for new patients and families

  • Provide personalized treatment recommendations, including referrals to community providers when appropriate

  • Lead group therapy sessions for caregivers of children with ADHD, anxiety, and co-occurring conditions such as Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD)

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to deliver high-quality, integrated care

  • Opportunities exist to contribute to program development, evaluation, and research initiatives—based on your interests and organizational needs

About You

  • You’re a licensed mental health professional (LPCC, LMFT, or LCSW) with a master’s degree in a relevant field—and you're passionate about providing excellent care to kids and families.

  • You’re currently licensed in California and open to getting licensed in other states (we’ll support you with that!)

  • You have experience working in integrated care settings and enjoy using evidence-based approaches, especially for pediatric ADHD and anxiety.

  • You’re tech-savvy, a quick learner, and excited about shaping the future of behavioral health through innovative, virtual care.

  • You’re energized by collaboration and interested in building better systems—whether through care model design, new tools, or team initiatives.

  • This role is remote, so you’re able to work from a private, secure location with strong internet—and you’re open to working at least 2 hours per week during peak times (M-F 3pm-8pm PT, and/or Saturday 8am-2pm)

Nice to Have

  • Licensed in additional states

  • Spanish proficiency (with pay differential)

raw.excerpt: At Quartermaster AI, we believe the ocean should be a safe and sustainably managed resource for all.
raw.description:
At Quartermaster AI, we believe the ocean should be a safe and sustainably managed resource for all. By leveraging cutting-edge AI and robotics, we unlock capabilities that were only recently impossible. Our distributed open-ocean systems enable every vessel to sense, compute, and communicate, enhancing maritime domain awareness for those who need it most.

Job Description: We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, ML Models to own the product strategy for the machine learning models that power our maritime domain awareness products. You will sit between our customers, our Machine Learning Engineers, and our company leadership. You will turn ambiguous operational problems into a clear model roadmap, help the team iterate on those models until they work in deployments, and make sure what we build fits a cohesive technical roadmap across hardware, software, data, and ML.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally comfortable in a model evaluation review and in a briefing with a senior executive or customer.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Spend time with users, analysts, and partners across a wide variety of customer markets to understand how they detect, track, and decide about maritime activity today. Turn what you learn into prioritized problem statements, user journeys, and measurable success criteria.

  • Define the model portfolio, covering what to build, in what order, and to what performance bar. Turn customer outcomes into model requirements: target metrics, acceptable error modes, latency and compute budgets at the edge, data needs, and evaluation datasets.

  • Work day to day with Applied ML and RF ML Engineers on experiment design, evaluation methodology, error analysis, and release criteria. Decide when a model is good enough to ship and when it needs another iteration. Hold a high bar for quality and a clear picture of what "better" means to customers.

  • Communicate model strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and risks to the C-suite, the board as needed, and customers and partners. Make complex technical topics understandable and decision-ready.

  • Own execution from ideation through launch and ongoing performance monitoring. Build feedback loops from fielded systems back into data collection, labeling, and retraining.

  • Establish metrics, experimentation practices, and evaluation standards that let the team ship models faster and with more confidence.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, program management, or technical leadership roles, including at least 2 years taking technical products from conception to launch.

  • Experience defining requirements, success metrics, and evaluation approaches for ML or AI-powered products, working directly with ML engineers and data scientists.

  • Experience running experiments and using data to drive product decisions (A/B testing, offline evaluation, or similar).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams of engineers, researchers, designers, and operators without direct authority.

  • Track record of briefing senior leaders, including executives or customers, on complex technical topics and shaping decisions.

  • Working fluency in Python and SQL sufficient to analyze data and engage in technical depth with engineers.

  • MS in an engineering or technical discipline, or both.

  • Hands-on experience with applied ML, such as predictive modeling, recommendation or ranking systems, or LLM/agentic pipelines, and familiarity with frameworks such as scikit-learn or TensorFlow.

  • Background or familiarity with maritime, defense, aerospace, or national security environments, and comfort translating operational needs into technical requirements.

Work Environment:

  • This is a remote position with collaboration via online tools.

  • Flexible working hours with occasional deadlines requiring high availability.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary

  • Flexible work hours and the option for remote work.

  • Opportunities for professional development and continued education.

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA is widely recognized as one of the most desirable employers, with some of the most talented people in the world working for us!
raw.description:
NVIDIA is widely recognized as one of the most desirable employers, with some of the most talented people in the world working for us! We believe open-weight models are foundational to American AI leadership and cybersecurity, and that trust in AI grows through participation, transparency, and broad scientific scrutiny. Our AI Safety & Security Engineering team builds and evaluates AI-powered tooling that helps find, validate, and patch software vulnerabilities. The agent harness and the platform it runs on are the substrate everything else builds on.

We are looking for a Harness/Platform Engineer to build that foundation. You will play a critical role in making the program's work possible, repeatable, and trustworthy. When a researcher runs an experiment, your platform decides whether the result can be reproduced tomorrow. Our current direction builds on NVIDIA NeMo agent tooling, and you will help shape where it goes. You will keep the whole loop visible, from environment to run to result. You will work closely with security research and evaluation engineers, learning their workflows and smoothing their paths. Good platform work here looks like fewer surprises: environments that behave, tooling that stays versioned, and runs that repeat. When something breaks, you will debug it with the people who felt it first. You will treat researcher time as precious and remove friction wherever you find it.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Harness development:Design, implement, and maintain the agent harness.

  • Evaluation infrastructure:Build the systems we use to run and reproduce experiments.

  • Reproducibility:Own environments, tooling, and repeatable runs.

  • Collaboration:Partner with security and evaluation engineers on their workflows.

What We Need To See:

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years of software engineering experience.

  • Technical core:Strong Python engineering plus comfort with containerized environments and CI/CD.

  • Infrastructure familiarity:Experience with agent frameworks, LLM orchestration, ML infrastructure, or evaluation harnesses.

  • Reproducibility instincts:Care for versioned tooling and repeatable results.

Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd:

  • NeMo experience:Hands-on work with NVIDIA NeMo or similar agent frameworks.

  • Security context:Exposure to security tooling or vulnerability research.

  • Developer experience:Building internal tools other engineers enjoy using.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until August 15, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager, preferably within the ecommerce/IT industry.
  • Strong proficiency in using Notion for project management and process documentation.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to visualize and optimize complex processes.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience developing and implementing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and process documentation.
  • Familiarity with agile project management methodologies and tools.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a passion for driving operational efficiency and scalability.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.

raw.description:
About this Role

We're looking for a Senior Creative Copywriter to bring Valerie's portfolio of consumer and eCommerce brands to life through exceptional writing, original ideas, and distinctive brand storytelling.

This is a creative role first and foremost. You'll develop brand voices, campaign concepts, messaging frameworks, social content, performance ads, website copy, and CRM campaigns that connect with audiences while driving business results.

You'll work across multiple brands and international markets, collaborating closely with Creative Directors, Designers, Brand Growth Pods, Performance, and Web & Digital Experience teams. We want someone who can move seamlessly between building a brand's long-term identity and writing sharp, commercially effective copy for everyday campaigns.

Great copy starts with human insight, originality, cultural understanding, and a genuine command of language. AI can support your process, but we want someone who can think independently, challenge generic ideas, and create work that feels distinctly human.

Success in this role means distinctive brand voices, original creative concepts, culturally relevant messaging, exceptional writing quality, faster creative delivery, fewer revisions, and copy that contributes to both brand building and commercial performance.

You could be a great fit if...

  • You see copywriting as a craft and care deeply about the quality, originality, and impact of your words.

  • You can turn consumer insights and brand strategy into compelling stories, campaign ideas, and messaging.

  • You have a strong conceptual mind and enjoy contributing ideas beyond the brief.

  • You understand how to balance brand storytelling with performance marketing and commercial objectives.

  • You have an exceptional command of English, including nuance, humour, idioms, and cultural references.

  • You can adapt your writing for different brands, audiences, platforms, and international markets.

  • You know how to make product benefits compelling without making the copy sound forced or salesy.

  • You challenge generic messaging and know when something sounds artificial, overused, or off-brand.

  • You're comfortable managing multiple brands and briefs without compromising on quality.

  • You enjoy collaborating with creative, design, strategy, and performance teams and can confidently explain your creative choices.

  • You use AI thoughtfully for research and exploration but can develop strong creative work independently.

  • You're proactive, receptive to feedback, and take ownership of your work from the first idea to final delivery.

Requirements

  • 5–7+ years of experience in creative copywriting, ideally within advertising, branding, creative agencies, or consumer-focused businesses.

  • An exceptional portfolio demonstrating original thinking, strong writing craft, and versatility across different brands and formats.

  • Outstanding written English, with a sophisticated understanding of tone, storytelling, grammar, and language.

  • Strong cultural understanding of English-speaking markets, particularly the US, UK, and Australia.

  • Experience developing brand narratives, tone-of-voice guidelines, messaging frameworks, and brand books.

  • Proven ability to conceptualise and write campaign ideas, headlines, taglines, and product launch messaging.

  • Hands-on experience writing for organic social, paid advertising, creator content, websites, landing pages, eCommerce, and CRM.

  • Understanding of how copy contributes to brand building, customer acquisition, engagement, and conversion.

  • Ability to adapt messaging for platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, and YouTube.

  • Good understanding of SEO, CRO, creative testing, and performance-led messaging.

  • Excellent editorial judgement, attention to detail, and ownership of final copy quality.

  • Ability to collaborate with Creative Directors, Designers, Strategists, and Performance specialists.

raw.description:
Talent Acquisition Specialist Snapshot

Curvion Blue is looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who knows how to find, assess, and attract high-performing sales talent.

This isn't a traditional HR recruiting role where you're posting jobs, waiting for applications, and hoping the right person wanders into the funnel.

You're going to be responsible for building and managing talent pipelines for sales roles across our business, with a heavy focus on identifying A-Players who can perform in high-ticket sales environments.

The ideal candidate has experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting and understands how to source, qualify, interview, and move candidates through a high-volume hiring process.

Bonus points if you've actually sold before. Extra bonus points if you've sold high-ticket.

We want someone who understands salespeople because they've been one, worked closely with them, or recruited them extensively.

Position Overview

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will own recruiting across Curvion Blue's sales organization and help us continuously build a bench of exceptional talent.

You'll work closely with leadership to understand what "great" looks like for each role, then take that profile into the market and find the people who match it.

This is a hands-on recruiting role for someone who enjoys sourcing, talking to candidates, assessing talent, and moving quickly.

You will be responsible for the full recruiting lifecycle, including sourcing, candidate outreach, screening, interview coordination, candidate evaluation, pipeline management, and offer management.

More importantly, you'll become an expert in identifying the difference between someone who sounds like a great salesperson and someone who can actually perform.

Your Core Responsibilities

Talent Sourcing

  • Build proactive talent pipelines for closers, setters, sales leaders, and other revenue-generating roles.

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, communities, databases, and creative outbound strategies.

  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies based on role requirements and candidate profiles.

  • Continuously build talent pools rather than starting from zero every time a role opens.

Candidate Qualification

  • Conduct recruiter screens to evaluate experience, communication, motivation, sales ability, and overall fit.

  • Identify candidates with demonstrated performance rather than relying solely on resume keywords.

  • Assess candidates against defined scorecards and role-specific success profiles.

  • Understand sales metrics, quotas, KPIs, close rates, lead flow, revenue, and other performance indicators.

  • Identify red flags and know when to move a candidate forward versus cut them from the process.

Sales Talent Acquisition

  • Become deeply familiar with high-ticket sales roles and the characteristics of top-performing setters, closers, sales directors, and sales leaders.

  • Understand the difference between legitimate sales experience and resume fluff.

  • Build relationships with high-performing sales professionals and maintain a warm talent network.

  • Help Curvion Blue become known as a destination for high-performing sales talent.

Candidate Experience

  • Own candidate communication throughout the recruiting process.

  • Keep candidates engaged, informed, and moving through each stage.

  • Represent Curvion Blue professionally and enthusiastically.

  • Create a candidate experience that reflects the level of talent we want to attract.

Recruiting Operations

  • Maintain accurate candidate data and pipeline stages in our ATS.

  • Track recruiting metrics including pipeline volume, conversion rates, time-to-fill, source performance, and quality of hire.

  • Coordinate interviews, skills assessments, roleplays, and other evaluation stages.

  • Partner with hiring managers to continuously improve the recruiting process.

  • Identify bottlenecks and recommend ways to improve recruiting efficiency.

Hiring & Onboarding Partnership

  • Support offer creation and candidate closing.

  • Help ensure strong candidates remain engaged through acceptance and start date.

  • Partner with the team to identify early indicators of successful hires.

  • Track quality of hire and use performance data to improve future recruiting decisions.

You SHOULD Apply If

  • You have 1+ years of Talent Acquisition, recruiting, or full-cycle recruiting experience.

  • You have experience recruiting salespeople, preferably revenue-generating roles.

  • You know how to source candidates rather than relying exclusively on inbound applicants.

  • You're comfortable conducting candidate screens and making recommendations to hiring managers.

  • You can quickly identify whether someone's experience actually matches what they're claiming.

  • You are highly comfortable talking to salespeople.

  • You understand performance-driven environments and aren't intimidated by metrics.

  • You can manage multiple open roles without losing track of candidates or details.

  • You're organized, responsive, and operationally strong.

  • You're comfortable working in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

  • You can communicate professionally with candidates at every level.

  • You're proactive. If you see a recruiting problem, your instinct is to solve it rather than wait for someone to tell you what to do.

BIG BONUS POINTS

  • You have past sales experience.

  • You have high-ticket sales experience.

  • You've been a setter, closer, AE, sales manager, or sales leader.

  • You've recruited high-ticket closers or setters before.

  • You've worked in coaching, consulting, SaaS, agency, or other performance-driven sales environments.

  • You understand sales compensation structures and can speak intelligently about earning potential with candidates.

  • You have an established network of sales talent.

  • You've recruited for remote sales organizations.

You SHOULD NOT Apply If

  • You only want to work inbound applications.

  • You don't enjoy outbound sourcing.

  • You need every step of your day mapped out for you.

  • You don't like metrics or performance accountability.

  • You're uncomfortable making judgment calls on candidates.

  • You struggle to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • You view recruiting as simply scheduling interviews and forwarding resumes.

  • You don't enjoy talking to people.

  • You're looking for a slow-moving corporate environment with six approval layers before anything gets done.

  • You have never recruited before and are looking for your first opportunity in Talent Acquisition.

Long-Term

You become one of the people Curvion Blue relies on to answer:

"We need five great salespeople. Where are they?"

And your answer is:

"Already working on it."

The Person We're Looking For

We're not looking for someone who simply wants to "work in HR."

We're looking for a talent hunter.

Someone who enjoys the chase.

Someone who can look at a LinkedIn profile and immediately start thinking:

"This person might be good. Let me find out."

You should enjoy talking to people, asking good questions, spotting potential, and figuring out what makes someone tick.

You should be competitive enough to care about winning the search, analytical enough to care about hiring quality, and organized enough to keep the machine running.

If you've sold before, you'll probably have a natural advantage here because you already understand how to build rapport, overcome objections, create urgency, and influence decisions.

If you've sold high-ticket, even better. You already understand the world our candidates operate in.

At Curvion Blue, we're building revenue engines for our clients. That requires exceptional people.

Your job is to help us find them.

Schedule:

  • Monday to Friday

  • 9AM - 6 PM (specific to your time zone)

Compensation Range: $50K - $80K

raw.description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable -- turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

As an Electrical Engineer, you will own the design, integration, and bring-up of the electronic systems that power Asimov. From power distribution to motor control to sensor integration, you will work across schematics, PCB layouts, harness design, and hardware debug -- ensuring every electrical decision holds up in the field and integrates cleanly with the broader mechanical and firmware stack.

What You'll Do

  • Design and review schematics and PCB layouts for power distribution units, motor driver boards, and actuator control electronics

  • Integrate wiring harnesses, PCBA enclosures, and motor controllers into mechanical assemblies from the ground up

  • Lead bring-up of power systems, sensors, and actuator subassemblies; diagnose and resolve issues across multiple hardware revisions

  • Define and run electrical and system-level test protocols, analyze failure modes, and iterate based on test data

  • Work closely with firmware and controls teams to ensure electrical design choices support stable, low-latency control loops

  • Apply expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression to ensure robust and field-reliable hardware

  • Contribute to Menlo's open-source design efforts, including PCB schematics and manufacturing documentation for the broader robotics community

What You'll Bring

  • 3 or more years of hands-on electrical engineering experience on high-complexity electromechanical products

  • Solid understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including motor drivers, sensors, and embedded hardware integration

  • Deep familiarity with low-voltage (under 60V) DC power systems, DC-DC converters, MOSFET gate drivers, current-sense amplifiers, and passive network design

  • Proficiency using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and CAN/UART sniffers for in-depth hardware debug

  • Expertise in connector selection, grounding strategies, harness routing, and EMI suppression techniques

  • Strong communication skills to drive alignment across firmware teams, mechanical engineers, and leadership

Bonus points for:

  • Experience with bipedal or humanoid robot hardware or legged locomotion platforms

  • Familiarity with CAN bus, motor controllers, and how electrical design choices affect firmware and control integration

  • Scripting experience in Python for hardware automation and data analysis

  • Familiarity with sim-to-real workflows and how hardware decisions affect locomotion policy training and transfer

Why Join Menlo?

You will be part of a tight-knit team defining the next generation of humanoid robots. With genuine ownership of the mechanical systems that bring Asimov to life, you will see your designs go from CAD to real-world deployments. If you thrive in fast-paced, open-collaborative environments, let's build the future of robotics together.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

What Regulatory Affairs contributes to Cardinal Health

Regulatory Affairs ensures total commercial and post-market compliance by performing end-to-end labeling approvals and managing mandatory product listings across human drug, medical device, and cosmetic portfolios. This function applies strong regulatory expertise to safeguard brand integrity, maintain federal and state regulatory alignment, and ensure compliance across private label and commercialized products.


The Regulatory Affairs operations team plans, oversees, and executes critical regulatory workflows—including artwork review, Structured Product Labeling (SPL), National Drug Code (NDC) directory maintenance, Unique Device Identification (UDI) submissions, and cosmetic establishment/product listings. Regulatory Affairs works closely with other internal partners to closely monitor changing FDA standards, state labeling mandates, and listing requirements to identify compliance risks, drive standard operating excellence, and maintain database integrity across all commercial lines.


Job Summary

The Supervisor, Regulatory Affairs manages regulatory programs, policies, and procedures to minimize risks and drive uncompromised supply chain integrity. Applying a strong knowledge of regulatory concepts and technical capabilities, the Supervisor collaborates cross-functionally to develop solutions to complex regulatory issues. When creating new standard operating procedures or revising existing practices, the Supervisor is responsible for ensuring alignment within the organization and monitoring adherence to policies.

  • Coordinates and supervises the daily activities of labeling and listing senior specialists.
  • Administers and reinforces internal policies and procedures to support zero-defect quality and regulatory objectives.
  • Interactions normally involve structured information exchange, complex problem resolution, and securing cross-functional consensus with senior leaders, vendor QA, and legal groups.

Responsibilities

Labeling Component & Packaging Approval

  • Rx and OTC Operations: Oversee and assist with QA approvals of labeling components for CAH Pharmaceutical Private Label brands.
  • Packaging approvals: Perform review and approval of labeling sections of Master Batch Records (MBR) and Requests for Repackaging.
  • Prop 65 & Claim Substantiation: Review and approve claims, bio-food statements, and California Proposition 65 assessments to ensure marketing material compliance.
  • Package Insert (PI) Management: Oversee proofing and disposition of Package Insert revisions.

Quality Systems, Investigations & Market Action Support

  • Deviation Resolution: Partner cross-functionally with QA managers to resolve complex packaging/labeling deviations. Lead efforts to procure defect photographs, secure complaint samples, and establish clear root-cause scope to define market action limits.
  • Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs): Facilitate and draft HHEs in collaboration with clinical medical safety experts to support potential market-action workflows.

System Administration & Database Integrity

  • Drug Listing Operations: Oversee drug listing activities for CAH Pharmaceutical Private Label products, providing guidance and review to support accurate and timely FDA submissions including CARES Act reporting and FDA Certification period.
  • GUDID & Kallik Systems: Manage the Medical Device Unique Device Identification (UDI) data submissions to GUDID and maintain regulatory labeling workflows within Kallik management system.
  • SOP & Workflow Refinements: Regularly update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to tighten regulatory compliance and streamline processes for efficiency and improved quality.

Cross-Functional Liaison & Team Leadership

  • Team Supervision: Direct, supervise, and mentor Specialists and Senior Specialists within the Quality Assurance and Regulatory compliance teams.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as a primary regulatory liaison between Quality, Packaging Operations, Commercial Product & Development, Pharmacuetical Product Sourcing, and external vendor QA groups (e.g., Sandoz, Innovative Labs).
  • Quality Agreements: Lead collaborative discussions regarding Quality Agreements, to ensure strategic external alignment.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4–8 years of experience in pharmaceutical/medical device Quality Assurance or Regulatory Affairs (Private Label experience preferred).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related scientific/technical field, or equivalent practical work experience preferred.
  • Preferred Technical Knowledge:
    • Familiarity with FDA Compliance Policy Guides (CPGs), 21 CFR Part 11, and USP standard testing.
    • Experience with Kallik, FACTS, or Veeva Vault QMS database architectures.
  • Working knowledge of eDRLS and I4I/A4L software applications for FDA drug listing submissions.

Anticipated salary range: $79,700 - $117,200

Bonus eligible: No

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 12/20/2026 if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.


The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is seeking an experienced Privacy Counsel to lead our privacy team and scale our privacy and data governance program as the company grows. This is a highly visible role at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare, data governance, data protection, and product innovation.

You will serve as a trusted legal advisor to senior leadership and partner closely with Security, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams. You will provide practical, risk-based guidance, lead critical privacy and data initiatives, and build systems that enable Abridge to innovate responsibly while meeting evolving regulatory and customer expectations.

The ideal candidate brings deep privacy expertise, sound business judgment, and experience operating with autonomy and leading a team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Abridge’s privacy program, providing practical, product-focused counseling to the Security, Product and Engineering teams.

  • Advise teams on privacy laws related to artificial intelligence, machine learning, clinical data, product development, secondary use of data and the responsible use of sensitive information.

  • Help develop, maintain, and scale global privacy programs.

  • Support data sharing and ecosystem questions (first/third-party, vendors, partners, internal platform services), including governance and contractual expectations in partnership with commercial counsel.

  • Monitor and respond to changes in privacy laws and regulations, including AI regulations.

  • Draft, maintain, and operationalize privacy policies, playbooks, templates, governance standards, and training materials that promote awareness and consistent decision-making across the company.

  • Work cross functionally with talented product and engineering teams in evaluating the impact of privacy and data protection laws and regulatory guidance on exciting product developments.

What You’ll Bring

  • Have 10+ years of experience with a mix of in-house, health tech, or technology-focused law firm roles.

  • Experience building, developing, advising, and evaluating programs that ensure products comply with laws, regulations, and external commitments.

  • Knowledge of HIPAA and other healthcare privacy requirements, as well as CCPA/CPRA, biometric privacy laws, and applicable U.S. state privacy and data security frameworks.

  • A practical, risk-based approach and the ability to balance legal, regulatory, business, and customer considerations.

  • Strong business judgment and the ability to work independently in an environment that values autonomy, accountability, and trust.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into clear, actionable guidance for technical and nontechnical audiences.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple high-priority matters in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.

  • A Juris Doctor degree from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

Bonus Points If…

  • Strong preference for prior experience on healthcare or health tech.

  • Familiarity with recent trends in the intersection of privacy regulations and artificial intelligence.

  • IAPP CIPP certification.

This is a hybrid role requiring employees to work from our SF or NYC office 3 days per week.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

Henkels & McCoy West works closely with clients from diverse markets to build enduring partnerships throughout the Western United States. Building on a 100-year legacy of performance and service to utility, commercial, industrial, and government clients, H&M West brings together extensive knowledge and innovation to deliver infrastructure construction solutions that meet future energy needs today.

H&M West is a purpose-driven company. Our core values guide our strategy, performance, and culture. We believe in maintaining an environment where team members can make an impact, grow, and thrive. You will build deep, trusted relationships with Kivo’s customers, lead implementations that set customers up for long-term success and serve as their strategic partner throughout their time with Kivo. This role thrives at the intersection of strategic account management and operational delivery in regulated environments. While primarily US-focused, the role may require occasional time-shifting to support EU-based implementation projects and customers.

Key Responsibilities

Implementation Consulting

Working in partnership with Kivo’s US based implementation team:

  • Solution Design: Engage early in the sales process to assist with the definition of requirements and project scoping
  • Deliver implementations: Lead end-to-end implementations of the Kivo platform through structured project management, and governance.
  • Design & configure: Facilitate discovery and design workshops; translate regulated process requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11) into configured platform solutions with documented decisions and guide the adoption of Kivo.
  • Support validation: Support the customer’s validation workstream by educating customers in the Kivo validation methodology and providing an orientation to Kivo documentation.
  • Support data migration: Partner with the Data Migration team on discovery, field mapping, dry-run coordination, and production cutover checklists for compliant data transfers.
  • Enable go-live: Guide customers through change management activities: defect triage, go-live readiness assessments, user training enablement, and post-go-live stabilization.

Customer Success

Working in partnership with the VP, Services:

  • Own account health: Manage a portfolio of NA accounts as the primary strategic point of contact post-implementation
  • Drive outcomes and expansion: Build and maintain tailored success plans aligned to each customer’s business goals; partner with Sales to identify, qualify, and advance expansion and upsell opportunities within your portfolio.
  • Executive alignment: Cultivate senior-level relationships within customer organizations; deliver executive-ready insights, business reviews, and ROI narratives that reinforce Kivo’s value.
  • Champion the customer: Serve as the primary voice of Kivo customers to the internal team—surface product feedback, advocate for roadmap priorities, and collaborate with Product on features and packaged offerings that reflect NA market needs.
  • Manage upgrades and adoption: Proactively manage customers through new feature releases and configuration changes, ensuring smooth adoption and building internal champions who drive platform utilization.
  • Retain and grow the base: Own GRR and NRR metrics for your portfolio; develop and execute playbooks for at-risk accounts, renewals, and expansion conversations in coordination with Sales leadership.

What You’ve Done

Required

  • 5–10+ years of experience in a customer success, implementation, or blended services role (e.g. Delivery Lead) within a life-sciences SaaS environment (pharma, biotech, med-device, or CRO).
  • Strong domain knowledge in Regulatory Affairs or Operations for pharmaceutical/biotech or medtech industries is a must
  • Demonstrated track record managing across a portfolio of accounts.
  • Working knowledge of regulated industry requirements (GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 / Annex 11) and comfort supporting validation deliverables (CSA/CSV).
  • Experience leading software implementations in a regulated environment, including project planning, stakeholder management, and go-live delivery.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to technical users and C-suite stakeholders alike.
  • Based in the US with the flexibility to occasionally time-shift for EU-based project collaboration.
  • Applied AI experience with AI models (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to build workflows, automations, or skills and the ability to guide customers in their use - not just as an end user

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with life-sciences SaaS platforms such as Vault (Quality/RIM/Clinical), MasterControl, TrackWise/ETQ, or comparable eQMS, eTMF, or RIM systems.
  • Prior experience working in hyper-growth, fast-paced environments and managing multiple priorities
  • PMP, Agile/Scrum certification, or equivalent project management training.

Who You Are

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent experience.
  • Drive: The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced environment and manage shifting priorities and maintain a balance outside the office, this is not 9/9/6.
  • Curiosity: Systems thinking mindset, and a curiosity to learn and understand the “why”
