Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.


Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This is a remote opportunity with Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


As a Territory Manager (TM), you will be responsible for driving therapy adoption, opening new accounts, and growing revenue for CardioMEMS. This is a hunter-oriented commercial role focused on expanding access, building high-impact customer relationships, and integrating the therapy into clinical workflows across implanting centers and community hospitals.


What You'll Do

  • Sales & Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with physicians, HF clinics, administrators, and key stakeholders. Deliver clinical, technical, and strategic presentations to drive therapy understanding and adoption. Lead pricing discussions, contract negotiations, and value-based conversations. Plan and execute educational events focused on hemodynamics, GDMT, published data, biomarkers, patient selection, and local case studies. Provide day-of-procedure support and post-operative troubleshooting as needed. Meet or exceed sales targets and execute quarterly business plans. Collaborate closely with Marketing, Professional Education, and Commercial Excellence teams. Track territory performance, customer engagement, and pipeline activity.
  • Account Management & Program Development: Conduct quarterly business reviews with key accounts to assess performance and identify growth opportunities. Partner effectively with Clinical Account Representative to support priority accounts with a unified strategy. Develop long-term relationships with both new and existing customers. Submit timely and accurate sales reports, forecasts, and competitive insights.
  • Market Development & Competitive Strategy: Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities across implanting and community sites. Use market insights to understand customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive dynamics. Build and execute territory strategies to increase market share and drive sustainable adoption. Maintain strong knowledge of CardioMEMS, competitive products, and alternative therapies.
  • Technical & Procedural Support: Provide on-call technical, clinical, and engineering support for field questions and procedural needs. Offer procedural case coverage across the region, ensuring high-quality support for implanting teams. Support HF clinics with training, education, clinical data collection, and new product introductions.
  • Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Adhere to FDA regulations, company policies, quality standards, and operating procedures. Maintain accurate documentation of sales activities, customer interactions, and expenses. Work collaboratively with internal partners, customers, contractors, and vendors. Interact with patients, when necessary, in a professional, compliant manner.

Experience You'll Bring

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of direct healthcare sales experience; 2+ years in cardiology structural heart/heart failure preferred.
  • Track record of ≥100% to quota for 2 consecutive years
  • Demonstrated success opening 3–5+ net-new accounts/year or expanding underdeveloped accounts to sustained utilization.
  • Strong understanding of payor and insurance reimbursement landscape.
  • Recent launch experience (Preferred) (last 3–5 years) leading 2–3 program or therapy launches/year with proof of sustainability (e.g., active clinic users, adherence to workflows, utilization trends), including: Pre-launch planning, Stakeholder alignment and executive sponsorship, Training, education, and clinical workflow integration, Post launch support and long-term sustainability plans.
  • Experience driving program implementation and ongoing program maturity, such as: HF clinic onboarding, Remote monitoring workflow development, Utilization ramp and adoption metrics
  • Strong executive presence, clinical/technical presentations to audiences of 1–50 stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional buying groups (value analysis committees, supply chain, service line leadership) Influencing multiple key stakeholders to drive growth.
  • Strong understanding of market dynamics
  • Strong commercial acumen with ability to produce data-driven territory strategies, forecasting models, and QBRs using CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), analytics, and Excel.
  • Willingness to travel 60-70% within territory, including some overnight and early/late case support.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cath Lab experience preferred
  • 2+ years in cardiology structural heart/heart failure preferred.
  • Experience at top MedTech organizations.
  • Experience operating in a competitive market with multiple industry players.
  • Familiarity with Cath lab/OR workflows.

Apply Now


Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives:


Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at , on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.


Divisional Information

Medical Devices


General Medical Devices:

Our medical devices help more than 10,000 people have healthier hearts, improve quality of life for thousands of people living with chronic pain and movement disorders, and liberate more than 500,000 people with diabetes from routine ﬁngersticks.


CRM

As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias, or irregular heartbeats.


Diabetes

We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.


Vascular

Abbott Vascular provides innovative, minimally invasive, and cost-effective products for treatment of vascular disease.


Neuromodulation

Our Neuromodulation business includes implantable devices compatible with mobile technology to help people who suffer from chronic pain and movement disorders. These non-opioid therapies allow us to provide interventional pain therapy to patients throughout the pain continuum.


Structural Heart

Structural Heart Business Mission: why we exist

Our business purpose is to restore health and improve quality of life through the design and provision of device and management solutions for the treatment of structural heart disease.


EP

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


HF

In Abbott’s Heart Failure (HF) business, we’re developing solutions to diagnose, monitor and manage heart failure, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.


Diagnostics

We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.


Abbott Molecular is a leader in molecular diagnostics and the analysis of DNA, RNA, and proteins at the molecular level.


Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key heath and therapeutic areas, including infections disease, cardiometabolic, informatics and toxicology.


Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments and informatics systems are often the first step in patient care decision making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.


Our rapid diagnostics solutions are helping address some of the world’s greatest healthcare challenges.


Nutrition

Our nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, and Glucerna® – to help them get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest lives.

raw.description:
Company Overview

Recognized as a Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Top Workplace for 14 consecutive years, including three years of being honored as number one! Join us at West Bend, where we believe that our associates are our greatest asset. We hire talented individuals who are conscientious, dedicated, customer focused, and able to build lasting relationships. We create and maintain an environment where you feel a sense of belonging and appreciation. Your diversity of thought, experience, and knowledge are valued. We’re committed to fostering a welcoming culture, offering you opportunities for meaningful work and professional growth. More than a workplace, we celebrate our successes and take pride in serving our communities.

Job Summary

Handle moderate to complex casualty claims independently, including Construction Defect, General Liability (Injury and Property Damage), Commercial Transportation, and Auto Bodily Injury claims.

Work Location

This position offers both remote and hybrid work locations.  Candidates who reside within 50 miles of an office location (West Bend, Madison, Appleton) will be offered a hybrid work schedule.  Candidates who are fully remote (beyond 50 miles) may occasionally be asked to travel to an office location for in-person engagement activities such as team meetings, training and corporate events.  

Responsibilities & Qualifications

At West Bend, we believe claims handling is more than managing files. It's about helping customers navigate challenging situations while delivering expertise, sound judgment, and exceptional service. We're looking for an experienced claims professional to independently manage complex casualty claims and serve as a trusted technical resource within our claims organization.

What You'll Do

Investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve moderate to highly complex casualty claims from initial loss through final disposition. This role handles a diverse and challenging caseload that may include:

  • Construction Defect claims
  • General Liability claims involving bodily injury and property damage
  • Commercial Transportation and Trucking claims
  • Commercial and Personal Auto Bodily Injury claims
  • High-exposure and litigated casualty losses

You'll independently evaluate coverage, liability, damages, and claim exposure while ensuring compliance with policy provisions, legal requirements, and department standards. Responsibilities include:

  • Conducting thorough investigations and analyzing evidence to support claim decisions
  • Evaluating policy coverage, liability, damages, and risk exposure
  • Establishing and maintaining appropriate claim reserves
  • Negotiating settlements and resolving complex claims efficiently and effectively
  • Managing litigated files and partnering with defense counsel on claim strategy
  • Preparing reservation of rights, coverage position, and denial letters
  • Reviewing contracts, indemnification agreements, and risk transfer provisions
  • Collaborating with insureds, claimants, attorneys, expert vendors, law enforcement, and other stakeholders
  • Analyzing accident reports, driver records, electronic logging data, medical records, and other claim documentation
  • Serving as a technical resource and mentor to team members by providing guidance, coaching, and training
  • Delivering exceptional customer service while maintaining quality, audit, and compliance standards

What You'll Bring to the Role

  • Significant experience handling casualty claims, including complex bodily injury exposures
  • Prior commercial trucking and transportation claims experience preferred
  • Experience managing litigated files and working directly with attorneys
  • Strong coverage analysis, liability evaluation, and investigative skills
  • Advanced knowledge of policy interpretation, contracts, risk transfer, and indemnification agreements
  • Sound negotiation, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple complex claims while maintaining strong customer relationships
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Insurance designations or coursework such as CPCU, AIC, AINS, ARM, SCLA, or similar professional education are a plus

Why You'll Love It Here

You'll join a collaborative team that values expertise, supports professional growth, and trusts you to make an impact. Here, you'll tackle meaningful and challenging claims, serve as a technical leader for others, and help deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers.

Share in Our Success

At West Bend, we believe great work should be rewarded. In addition to competitive compensation and outstanding benefits, eligible employees can earn an annual Performance Bonus Plan payout of up to 18% of base salary, based on both company and individual performance. When you help drive our success, you'll share in the rewards.

Salary Statement

The salary range for this position is $70,000-$90,000.  

 

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity.  Compensation decisions are made by West Bend and are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. 

Benefits

West Bend offers a comprehensive benefit plan including but not limited to:  

  • Medical & Prescription Insurance 
  • Health Savings Account 
  • Dental Insurance 
  • Vision Insurance 
  • Short and Long Term Disability 
  • Flexible Spending Accounts 
  • Life and Accidental Death & Disability  
  • Accident and Critical Illness Insurance 
  • Employee Assistance Program 
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match 
  • Pet Insurance 
  • Paid Time Off. Standard first year PTO is 17 days, pro-rated based on month of hire. Enhanced PTO may be available for experienced candidates
  • Bonus eligible based on performance 
  • West Bend will comply with any applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act for Colorado employees, in accordance with its plans and policies.

EEO

West Bend provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, and promotion.

  • Express + React Router 7 (web)
  • tRPC
  • React Native (mobile)
  • React Query
  • Postgres + Redis

What You’ll Do:
  • Own features end-to-end — from design discussion to production rollout and monitoring.
  • Ship TypeScript on the web app, Node/Express backend, and/or mobile app.
  • Design and build fault-tolerant, HIPAA-compliant services with a strong focus on privacy, security, and stability.
  • Document your work so others can move fast.
  • Use the latest AI tools and SDKs to build AI-enriched features.

  • Bring 6+ years of hands-on software experience, with advanced TypeScript skills.

  • Have built some great things you can show us and describe in detail.

  • Have written reliable tests with Vitest, Cypress, Jest, etc.

You’re an excellent fit if you…
  • Have used AI SDKs (AI SDK, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) with production software.
  • You have built or maintained HIPAA-compliant or other regulated healthcare software.
  • Are comfortable with internal tooling (e.g., Retool) and thorough documentation habits.

raw.excerpt: NVIDIA Networking product security team is looking for an outstanding technical security architect with hands-on experience to help us improve the security posture of NVIDIA networking products.
raw.description:
NVIDIA Networking product security team is looking for an outstanding technical security architect with hands-on experience to help us improve the security posture of NVIDIA networking products. In this role you will partner with firmware, hardware, and architecture teams on the security architecture, to reduce risk, threats, and vulnerabilities while driving new security features that affect millions of devices all over the world!


What you'll be doing:

  • Be involved in the security architecture of NVIDIA Networking firmware — trust boundaries, privilege separation between firmware domains, device identity and key storage, secure boot and chain of trust, and secure update and anti-rollback flows.
  • Perform security threat modeling of firmware and embedded subsystems across NVIDIA Networking products.
  • Analyze complex firmware and hardware/firmware interactions to identify security weaknesses, including boot flows, privileged execution environments, and host- and network-facing management interfaces.
  • Define security features and mitigations spanning the full device lifecycle — provisioning, attestation, debug authorization, runtime hardening, and field update. Guide the engineering teams throughout the implementation.
  • Translate threat models into actionable security requirements and architectural decisions, and review designs and implementations against them.
  • Partner with hardware and ASIC architects to specify the security primitives firmware depends on, and define how they are used across the product line.
  • Drive secure development practices for firmware — memory-safe coding patterns in C, static analysis, and fuzzing of firmware-exposed interfaces — and make sure development processes meet security and coding standards.

What we need to see:

  • Academic degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Demonstrated experience of 8+ years in product security, firmware security, or security research, including hands-on work with embedded or firmware codebases.
  • Experience defining security policy models — authorization schemes, RBAC, and administrative role separation — including how policy is expressed, enforced, and administered in production.
  • Familiarity with applied cryptography (including secure boot, code signing, and attestation), threat modeling, common attack vectors, and mitigation techniques.
  • Ability to work independently, and collaboratively in a constantly evolving environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • M.Sc. or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or related technical field.
  • Experience with hardware/software interfaces in networking devices — register and MMIO programming models, DMA, mailbox and doorbell mechanisms, PCIe configuration and management interfaces, and the firmware that drives them.
  • Experience with hardware roots of trust and hardware-enforced isolation (MPU/MMU, secure enclaves, fuse/OTP-based provisioning) in SoCs or ASICs.
  • Hands-on experience with networking software — device drivers, control plane, management interfaces, or embedded network operating systems — and an understanding of how these components interact with firmware.
  • Familiarity with high-scale deployment, the data center security ecosystem and its operational challenges.

With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our special engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 23, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Se EXCLUYE ESPAÑA

SECTOR: Centros de Datos / Construcción Industrial / Infraestructuras Críticas.

MODALIDAD: 100 % remoto con viajes puntuales por Europa.

FUNCIÓN Y RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Liderar y coordinar el proceso de diseño multidisciplinar de proyectos de Centros de Datos de gran escala, incluyendo desarrollos hyperscale y de colocation.
  • Coordinar las disciplinas CSA (Civil, Structural & Architectural) y MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing), garantizando la correcta integración de las soluciones de diseño.
  • Gestionar y supervisar las consultoras externas de ingeniería y diseño, asegurando la calidad y coherencia de los entregables técnicos.

  • Colaborar con los equipos de construcción para garantizar una transición adecuada del diseño a la ejecución en obra.
  • Trabajar conjuntamente con los equipos de commissioning y puesta en marcha para asegurar que las soluciones de diseño respondan a los requisitos de funcionamiento, pruebas y entrega final.
  • Gestionar los cambios de diseño y evaluar su impacto en los plazos, costes, calidad y ejecución del proyecto.
  • Mantener una comunicación fluida con el Project Manager, el cliente, los equipos de ingeniería y los contratistas durante todas las fases del proyecto.
  • Contribuir a la mejora continua de los estándares de diseño, los procesos de coordinación y las buenas prácticas en proyectos de Centros de Datos.

REQUISITOS, EXPERIENCIA Y COMPETENCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería, Arquitectura, Ingeniería de Edificación, Ingeniería de Instalaciones o disciplina relacionada.
  • Experiencia demostrable en gestión y coordinación del diseño de proyectos de Centros de Datos.
  • Experiencia directa en proyectos de gran escala, preferiblemente en entornos hyperscale, colocation o infraestructuras críticas.
  • Experiencia coordinando equipos multidisciplinares de diseño, incluyendo las disciplinas CSA y MEP.
  • Experiencia gestionando consultoras externas, entregables técnicos, interfaces de ingeniería y procesos de revisión y aprobación de diseños.
  • Capacidad para evaluar la calidad del diseño, su constructibilidad y su integración con las fases de construcción y puesta en marcha.
  • Experiencia en planificación, seguimiento de hitos, gestión de riesgos y resolución de incidencias técnicas.
  • Conocimiento de los procesos de diseño y desarrollo de proyectos de construcción complejos.
  • Capacidad para coordinar múltiples interlocutores y gestionar prioridades en un entorno internacional.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, organización, liderazgo técnico y resolución de problemas.
  • Disponibilidad para realizar viajes puntuales a proyectos en Europa.

Se valorará especialmente la experiencia en la gestión integral del diseño de centros de datos desde las fases conceptuales hasta el diseño de detalle y la entrega a construcción, así como la experiencia trabajando con promotores, operadores, consultoras de ingeniería y contratistas principales.

IDIOMAS

  • Inglés nivel profesional, hablado y escrito (imprescindible).

CONTRATO Y CONDICIONES

  • Contrato laboral de duración determinada de 18 meses.
  • Modalidad de trabajo 100 % remoto desde uno de los países autorizados.
  • Viajes puntuales a proyectos en diferentes ubicaciones de Europa.
  • Retribución competitiva, en función de la experiencia y del país de residencia.
  • Participación en importantes proyectos internacionales de Centros de Datos de gran escala.
  • Colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares en un entorno internacional y técnicamente exigente.

¿Te interesa esta oportunidad?

Si tienes experiencia en gestión del diseño de Centros de Datos y buscas un nuevo reto profesional con alcance internacional y modalidad de trabajo remoto, queremos conocer tu perfil.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 22-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.


WHAT TEAM YOU’LL BE PART OF

You will join the Account Management team, operating under the leadership of Antoine, Chief Customer Officer, and coordinated by regional team leads. The team is present globally across EMEA, the US, and APAC, serving some of the world's top mobile app publishers.

In short, Account Managers are the strategic partners of Adikteev's clients. You would own the relationship end-to-end: from onboarding a new client, to making sure their campaigns are live and hitting performance targets, to presenting QBRs and identifying growth opportunities. Day-to-day, this means coordinating closely with the Campaign Management team on performance and optimizations and with Sales on account expansion.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As an Account Manager for APAC, you will help build and scale one of Adikteev’s highest-potential regions. Concretely, this means:

  • Act as the region’s retargeting & user-acquisition expert and the trusted strategic advisor to your clients;

  • Own a portfolio of key accounts end-to-end — from onboarding, to hitting performance targets, to QBRs and long-term growth planning;

  • Identify and lead upsell and expansion opportunities, partnering with Sales on advanced deals;

  • Turn account insights into clear, actionable feedback for our Product and BI teams;

  • Set the standard for onboarding, delivery, and client engagement across the team, and share best practices on working with different app developers.

WHO YOU ARE

You will thrive in this role, and be a great fit for the Account Management team at Adikteev, if you bring:

Experience & background:

  • 5+ years of experience in an account management role;

  • Exposure to AdTech, ideally on the demand side;

  • Exposure to the gaming industry;

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • A proactive approach to delivering insights and service to clients;

  • Strong analytical background and work experience;

  • Ability to interact with a product team, data scientists and engineers;

  • Familiarity with the programmatic ecosystem (a plus);

  • Good understanding of tracking solutions, cost aggregation and the broader AdTech ecosystem;

  • Ability to perform competitive analysis, build long-term client strategy, and lead upselling efforts;

  • Ability to prepare business reviews (QBRs) and top-notch presentations.

Languages:

  • Chinese (Mandarin): native or bilingual — mandatory;

  • Korean: full professional proficiency (business level) — mandatory;

  • English: full professional proficiency — mandatory;

  • Japanese: a plus.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs ;

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years ;

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Friday afternoons off) ;

  • 1.7 paid leave per month from the 1st month ;

  • Festive holiday season support for Chuseok & Seollal ;

  • Flexible remote working policy ;

  • Mental Health support ;

  • Medical check-up support.

Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of South Korea, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are.

OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • Call with Claire, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner;

  • Team fit interview with Antoine, Chief Customer Operations Officer and John, Country Manager (Korea);

  • Use case to complete remotely and present to Ashmita, Lead Account Manager EMEA, and Nadya, VP of Sales EMEA

  • In-person meeting with the team. You will meet Bill and Jillian, Account Managers together with Junsung, Sales Director APAC and John.

  • Final interview with Clément, Global Chief Operations Officer and Taoufik, Chief Revenue Officer.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead UX Designer to define and lead the experience strategy for BMC’s Agentic Experience initiative. This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of enterprise UX, AI and agentic systems, and product innovation. You will design how people understand, direct, collaborate with, supervise, and trust autonomous and semi-autonomous agents across complex workflows. You will partner with product, engineering, AI, research, and domain experts to translate agentic AI capabilities into clear, responsible, and valuable experiences for customers operating mission-critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Experience Design (core focus)
  • Define the end-to-end cross-product experience strategy for agentic AI systems, including intent capture, planning, recommendations, tool use, execution, status communication, exception handling, and outcomes.
  • Design human-agent interaction patterns that make autonomy, system reasoning, confidence, permissions, and consequences understandable without overwhelming users.
  • Create experiences for single-agent and multi-agent workflows across conversational, visual, and workflow-based interfaces.
  • Design appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, approvals, escalation paths, reversibility, auditability, and recovery mechanisms for high-impact actions.
  • Translate complex AI capabilities, constraints, and failure modes into intuitive enterprise experiences that build trust and support informed decision-making.
Experience Strategy, Research & Validation
  • Shape the experience vision, principles, journeys, and interaction model for BMC’s agentic AI ecosystem.
  • Lead discovery with customers, users, product teams, and domain experts to identify high-value agentic use cases and unmet needs.
  • Prototype and test AI workflows, agent behaviours, trust cues, and interaction patterns through iterative research and usability evaluation.
  • Define experience success measures for task completion, comprehension, trust, adoption, efficiency, and responsible use.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative evidence to influence product direction and prioritize improvements.
Design Leadership & Collaboration
  • Partner with product managers, AI engineers, architects, researchers, product designers, content designers, and domain specialists from concept through production.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to align use cases, system capabilities, user needs, risks, and experience outcomes.
  • Establish reusable agentic UX patterns, standards, and guidance that scale across products while maintaining consistency and accessibility.
  • Provide design direction, critique, and mentorship, raising craft quality and strengthening AI experience design practices across the organization.
  • Communicate experience strategy, design rationale, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leaders and technical and non-technical stakeholders

Must-Have Skills & Experience

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, UX Design, Cognitive Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of product or UX design experience in complex enterprise products, IT systems, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, data, or other highly technical environments.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking, end-to-end experience design, interaction design depth, and measurable product impact.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional initiatives.
Agentic AI & UX Expertise
  • Demonstrated experience successfully designing AI-powered, generative AI, or agentic experience strategies to real products or to enterprise workflows, beyond prototypes or conceptual exploration.
  • Understanding of MCP, agent-to-agent protocols, AI observability, evaluation, governance, and enterprise security considerations.
  • Practical understanding of agentic AI frameworks and concepts, including agents, tools, memory, context, planning, reasoning, orchestration, multi-agent collaboration, RAG, and human oversight.
  • Experience mapping AI workflows and ecosystems across users, agents, enterprise applications, APIs, data, permissions, policies, and operational constraints.
  • Ability to design for probabilistic behaviour, uncertainty, latency, failure, explainability, safety, trust, and responsible AI.
  • Expertise in Figma and vibe design, with the ability to make complex interactions tangible for users and engineering teams.
  • Strong user research, facilitation, storytelling, and executive communication skills

Our commitment to you!

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

BMC is committed to equal opportunity employment regardless of race, age, sex, creed, color, religion, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy, disabled veteran or status as a protected veteran. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, visit the accommodation request page.

BMC Software maintains a strict policy of not requesting any form of payment in exchange for employment opportunities, upholding a fair and ethical hiring process.

The annual base salary range represents the low and high end of the BMC salary range for this position. Actual salaries depend on a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training, licensure, and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

The range listed is just one component of BMC's employee compensation package. Other rewards may include a variable plan and country specific benefits.

At BMC, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at /near the top of the range. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $152,925 - $254,875

raw.description:
Overview

The Sr. Revenue Integrity Analyst owns advanced revenue analysis and key month-end controls that support accurate invoicing, revenue application, inventory reconciliation, revenue cycle processes, and financial reporting within the complex chart review business function. This role investigates revenue leakage, applies revenue, manages revenue SLAs, analyzes inventory and financial variances, and leads resolution of invoice and client issues. The role develops actionable reporting, partners across functions to correct root causes, and mentors junior analysts.

Responsibilities

  • Own month-end revenue validation controls, including reconciliation of outputs, exceptions, adjustments, open inventory, and close support schedules.
  • Investigate potential missed, delayed, misstated, or incorrectly billed revenue using paid claim transactional data, invoice detail, contractual terms, and internal financial records. Compares disparate data sources to uncover and apply missed opportunity.
  • Perform and oversee reconciliation of client self-billing files, including data transformation, loading, quality verification, exception analysis, and final invoice support.
  • Review invoicing accuracy and contract alignment; apply non-standard contractual pricing and resolve discrepancies, disputes, and fee paybacks. Support appropriate closure of inventory.
  • Analyze period-over-period movement, inventory aging, throughput, financial data, and other financial variances.
  • Identify root causes of financial underperformance and communicate findings, revenue impact, options, and recommended corrective actions in formal business settings.
  • Lead invoice-detail questions and escalations with internal and external stakeholders; prepare facts and resolution recommendations for complex client issues.
  • As needed develop recurring reports, dashboards, forecasts, and insights that monitor KPI and SLA performance, revenue risk, service delivery, and financial accuracy.
  • Partner with Finance, Operations, Technology, and Engineering to reconcile inventory and correct invoicing or revenue application system and process issues.
  • Use Power BI, automation, and agentic tools to improve analytical quality, control effectiveness, cycle time, and operating efficiency.
  • Mentor junior analysts and establish consistent approaches for reconciliations, investigations, documentation, and escalation.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, professional training, and relevant work experience. High school diploma or GED required.

  • 5-8 years’ experience in finance, accounting, healthcare payment integrity, revenue cycle or related fields.

  • Strong experience in revenue integrity, revenue cycle management, invoice standards, financial and accounting best practices, inventory management, healthcare payment integrity, and healthcare claims processing.
  • Ability to own multistep month-end controls and resolve complex discrepancies across client-supplied files, invoice detail, and internal financial systems.
  • Advanced Excel and data-analysis skills; proficiency developing reports and insights in Power BI or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare payment integrity, claims processing, finance/accounting, and billing cycles.
  • Ability to interpret client-specific invoicing logic and contractual requirements and communicate findings to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating across Finance, Operations, Technology, Engineering, and client-facing teams to implement corrective actions.
  • Strong organization, written communication, client communication, mentoring, and issue-resolution skills.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Interpret complex transactional, financial, contractual, and inventory data.
  • Problem-solve and think critically to isolate root causes and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Communicate findings and exchange information with clients, leaders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Complete complex analyses independently while appropriately escalating material risks and decisions.
  • Make timely decisions within month-end, invoicing, and client-resolution workflows.
  • Maintain focus and manage multiple recurring deliverables, investigations, and deadlines.
  • Assess the accuracy, completeness, and thoroughness of reconciliations, reports, and supporting documentation.
  • Learn and apply new systems, processes, contract terms, and automation approaches.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $80,000 to $95,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 11/22/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using.

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.

WHAT TEAM YOU WILL BE PART OF

You will be joining as Machine Learning Team Lead, leading our Machine Learning team. This team has full ownership of Adikteev's ML ecosystem, building and maintaining the systems that power the core of our business at massive scale. They operate with a strong product ownership mindset, working at the intersection of research and production, where the models they ship have a direct and measurable impact on billions of real-time decisions every day.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Team Leadership: Lead, grow, and manage the Machine Learning team, setting technical direction and priorities while directly managing and mentoring ML engineers, including senior+ profiles.

  • Model Development: Design and train predictive models for CTR, CR, VTA, bid shading, and auction-win probability across display and video inventory.

  • Platform Engineering: Scale our ML platform, feature stores, training pipelines, model versioning, A/B experimentation, to support multiple model families running in production simultaneously.

  • Real-time Systems: Drive sub-10ms inference at high QPS through model optimization (ONNX), efficient serving, and latency-aware architecture decisions, informed by hands-on DSP/RTB experience.

  • MLOps & Observability: Own end-to-end ML workflows from data ingestion through monitoring: drift detection, shadow scoring, A/B tests, and automated retraining triggers; drive design reviews, ADRs, and mentoring of the team. Translate business objectives into technical strategies.

  • Cross-functional Partnership: Work closely with Tech, Reporting, Product and Analytics teams to define ML KPIs, instrument experiments, and communicate model performance to stakeholders up to Comex level.

  • Applied Research: Design and set up a neural network for adtech from the ground up, taking it from prototype to production in our bidding stack.

★ WHO YOU ARE

You could be a great addition to our Engineering team as Machine Learning Team Lead if you have:

  • 8+ years of industry ML engineering experience, with 3+ years in a technical leadership or team lead role, owning production ML systems at scale.

  • Required DSP background: hands-on experience building and operating ML systems within a DSP (Demand-Side Platform) environment is mandatory, including deep familiarity with programmatic advertising, RTB, mobile attribution (MMP ecosystem, SKAdNetwork, Privacy Sandbox), and bidding infrastructure.

  • Deep expertise in recommender systems and/or LTV/churn modeling within an adtech context.

  • Strong command of the modern ML stack: Python, PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, MLflow or Weights & Biases, Spark or Flink for feature engineering.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, you write production-grade, reviewable code and care about system reliability.

  • Proven experience leading or mentoring a team of ML engineers, with the ability to set technical vision while remaining hands-on.

  • Track record of delivering value incrementally, shipping working software in small, frequent increments rather than large multi-quarter projects.

  • Clear, concise communicator who can translate model performance into business impact for non-technical audiences and senior leadership.

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with real-time serving infrastructure: Triton, TorchServe, Ray Serve, or custom low-latency gRPC services.

    • Scikit-learn, MLflow

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in France or the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

Competitive Salary between 130,000€ and 150,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

  • Competitive Salary ;

  • Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs;

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years ;

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off) ;

  • “RTT” ;

  • Mental Health support ;

  • Flexible remote working policy ;

  • Regular team-life event / activity ;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are.

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR call with Maxime, Talent Acquisition Lead ;

  • Tech fit interview with Gwenaelle, Staff Machine Learning Engineer, & Pedro, Senior Machine Learning Engineer

  • Team fit interview with Cédric, Chief Technical Officer

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

Welty Energy, an affiliate of Welty, is a professional services company specializing in program and project management, transmission line engineering, substation engineering and construction oversight on transmission, substation and distribution projects ranging in voltages from 4kV to 765kV.

Headquartered in Akron, OH, and working nationally, Welty Energy currently manages approximately $500 million in construction projects for electric utilities in the Midwest and Northeast regions of the U.S.

As the Senior, you will be involved with consulting on select projects as well as providing assistance to the Welty Project Management Team and mentoring junior Estimators.

This position can be remote in the mainland United States, operating in ET hours.

Note: If you’re an engineer who has a desire to influence projects at the most impactful stage, estimating sets the foundation for success and your technical skills help shape it

As a Senior S&T Estimator, you may:

  • Work with internal substation layout teams for preliminary substation designs.
  • Create and review substation and transmission/distribution line estimates using Sage and Navigator software.

  • Review/Aide supplemental support estimates such as, but not limited to, access roads, forestry, SCADA/IT network, fiber, testing and commissioning, and related.

Contract: Full-time, Independent Contractor

Location: Remote — we hire across multiple jurisdictions

Hours: US Eastern Time

Our Firm

Sterlington PLLC is a full-service law firm focusing on complex corporate, litigation, executive compensation, and private wealth matters. As a firm, we focus on the economic as well as the legal aspects of our matters. Among other strengths, Sterlington is the ultimate law firm for founders, senior executives, and UHNWIs as well as their related businesses.

We are remote-first, and our support teams work as one global Legal Operations function across multiple time zones.

Learn more at www.sterlingtonlaw.com

The Opportunity

We are looking for a first-class Senior Legal Practice Assistant to provide white glove support service to our firm’s partners and attorneys. By gaining a deep understanding of each partner’s practice, you will support them to execute on client matters, run the administrative engine behind the work, coordinate with stakeholders across the firm, and help ensure our business and our clients’ goals are achieved.

We are looking for someone who is curious and practical in using AI and technology to improve day-to-day work, streamline processes and support attorneys more efficiently.

This is a broad role for someone who wants more than calendar management. Alongside core executive support, you will work on documents, matter coordination, process and project management. As we scale, we are adding elite talent to this team.

What You’ll Do

  • The partner’s day. Complex, multi-time-zone diaries: schedule, protect, and make the call when two things collide. Inboxes with judgment, not just volume: triage, surface, draft the first pass, chase what has gone quiet. Meeting packs, briefing notes, agendas, and the follow-up actions afterwards. Travel end to end, including the changes in flight and the reconciliation afterwards.
  • The client-facing paperwork. Engagement letters prepared, circulated and tracked through to signature and return. Client and prospect correspondence written to a standard that reflects who we act for. Contact records and CRM entries that are accurate because you keep them that way.
  • The documents. Formatting, versioning, comparison, and preparing the execution copy to firm standard. Filing that means anyone can find the document, not just you.
  • Time and billing, to the flagging line. Prompting and chasing time capture. Flagging billable items, disbursements and expenses to Finance for processing. You need enough billing literacy to spot what matters. You will not be processing it.
  • How you work. Anything belonging to the wider function goes through the Legal Operations intake channel rather than into your own list. You work to the team’s published response standards. You reach for AI first and tell us when you have found a faster way.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years supporting partners, senior fee earners or C-suite executives, ideally in law or professional services.
  • Fluent English, verbal and written
  • Strong proficiency with MS Office, Aderant or similar practice management software, PowerBI or similar data analytics dashboards, Claude, CoPilot or similar AI tools, Asana or similar project management tools
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills; able to carry several workstreams without dropping detail
  • Ability to remain poised under pressure, multitask, and prioritize effectively
  • Strong team orientation and a preference for collaboration
  • Experience with a practice management, billing, time-capture or document management system — or evidence you have learned a comparable system quickly

At Sterlington, we believe that world-class talent has no boundaries. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive environment where unique perspectives are valued and every individual has the opportunity to thrive. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Job Description

Job Title: Senior Golang Engineer

About the Opportunity:

MateHR is currently seeking a highly experienced Backend Engineer on behalf of one of our most ambitious clients rapidly scaling fintech startup that's reshaping global transaction services and B2C Financing. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-scaling company with a cross-continent presence. You'll become part of a passionate, collaborative team committed to delivering impactful financial solutions.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Golang Developer, you will play a key role in expanding the company's global remittance and payout capabilities. You'll design and build backend services that integrate new payout partners, support additional currencies, and abstract complex banking and payment flows into simple, reliable APIs.

This role goes beyond API integrations—you will help architect the core layers that normalize fragmented global financial systems, ensuring transactions are consistent, secure, and scalable regardless of destination.

Your Impact:

Backend Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Golang

  • Build clean, well-structured RESTful APIs that support high-volume financial transactions

  • Apply Domain-Driven Design and modular architecture principles

  • Ensure strong data consistency, security, and privacy across all systems

  • Write high-quality, maintainable, production-grade code with strong test coverage

  • Contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision-making

Reliability & Operations:

  • Own features end-to-end, from design through deployment and post-release support
  • Implement gradual rollout strategies (feature flags, traffic ramp-ups, blue/green deployments)
  • Define and monitor SLAs/SLOs using metrics, logging, and tracing

  • Participate in an on-call rotation following a you build it, you run it model

Collaboration & Ownership:

  • Work closely with Product, QA, and other engineering teams

  • Support compliant financial solutions aligned with regulatory and customer requirements

  • Take initiative, make decisions within your domain, and drive improvements proactively

Your Background:

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with strong hands-on experience in Golang
  • Proven experience building and operating scalable backend systems

  • Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL (schema evolution, transaction isolation, query optimization)

  • Experience with Redis and common caching patterns

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous processing (Kafka, message queues, event-driven systems, goroutines)

  • Experience working with observability stacks (logging, metrics, distributed tracing)

  • Proficiency with Docker and containerized environments

  • Strong understanding of RESTful API design principles

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • High sense of ownership and accountability
  • Clear communicator who collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams

  • Curious, growth-oriented mindset with openness to feedback

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience setting up or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

Why Join:

  • Work on mission-critical fintech systems with real global impact
  • High ownership and autonomy in technical decision-making

  • Exposure to complex, real-world financial infrastructure challenges

  • Opportunity to grow with a fast-scaling, international product

70 000 EUR - 110 000 EUR (Annual)

If you are passionate about backend engineering excellence and eager to contribute to a thriving fintech leader, MateHR welcomes your application.

raw.description:
We are hiring an experienced Klaviyo Specialist for our client, a growing retention email marketing agency that has generated over $30 million in revenue for subscription eCommerce brands.

This role is for someone who knows Klaviyo inside out, has experience managing multiple agency accounts, and can independently execute high-performing email campaigns and flows.

A Day in This Role

You start your day inside Klaviyo, reviewing campaigns and automated flows across your client accounts.

One brand needs its subscription cancellation flow updated. Another has an abandoned cart flow that needs testing, while a third has a campaign scheduled to go live.

You check the segmentation, triggers, links, and tracking to make sure everything is working before launch.

Throughout the day, you collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to keep campaigns moving.

You end the day knowing your work has helped multiple eCommerce brands run stronger retention email programs.

Must-Have Requirements

Please apply only if you meet all five requirements:

  1. 2+ years of hands-on Klaviyo experience working with eCommerce brands generating $1M+ in monthly revenue.

  2. Subscription eCommerce experience, including cancellation and downgrade flows, and integrations with Skio, Loop, Recharge, Ordergroove, or similar platforms.

  3. Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. Freelance-only or in-house-only experience is not sufficient.

  4. Experience managing 5+ accounts independently while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

  5. Strong written English (B2+ minimum) and the ability to communicate clearly in a remote, asynchronous team.

What You'll Do

  • Build, manage, and optimize Klaviyo flows, including Welcome, Abandoned Cart, Post-Purchase, Winback, and subscription retention flows.

  • Build, schedule, and launch email campaigns across multiple client accounts.

  • Perform pre-launch QA, checking segmentation, triggers, links, rendering, and tracking.

  • Monitor deliverability, maintain list hygiene, and run A/B tests to improve performance.

  • Collaborate with the CSM, Project Manager, Designer, and Copywriter to deliver campaigns accurately and on time.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You have general email marketing experience but limited hands-on Klaviyo expertise.

  • You've only worked as a freelancer or in-house marketer without agency experience.

  • You haven't worked with subscription eCommerce brands or built cancellation and downgrade flows.

  • You need constant supervision or struggle to manage multiple client accounts independently.

  • You frequently miss deadlines, overlook campaign details, or struggle with written communication.

Why Join?

  • Work with established seven-figure subscription eCommerce brands.

  • Enjoy a fully remote role with autonomy over your daily schedule.

  • Join a small, experienced team focused on delivering measurable results.

  • Grow your career with a clear path from Klaviyo Specialist to Client Success Manager.

Ready to Apply?

If you have proven Klaviyo agency experience, understand subscription eCommerce, and can confidently manage multiple accounts without constant supervision, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Distinguished National Support Engineer provides the highest level of technical expertise and experience to the Fujifilm Healthcare Medical Informatics business covering all currently offered products including, but not limited to: storage systems, PACS (Radiology/Cardiology), VNA, Mobility, 3D Systems, Syncomm and Clinical Information Systems. While this position may provide direct support to the Technical Assistance Center (TAC), the primary focus is technical leadership and direction be provided to all other functional departments within the business including to but not limited to development. In some cases, support will also be provided to the modality side of the business as well.

The Distinguished National Support Engineer will assist in driving all aspects of customer support related issues that are mostly technical in nature, although system administration and clinical support is provided utilizing the escalation process. The Distinguished National Support Engineer, will evaluate, triage, present and work in concert with development leadership to ensure an optimal customer experience and timely resolution to high-priority issues.

Additionally, the Distinguished National Support Engineer is tasked with documenting all activities associated with an issue and providing communication (service bulletins, procedures, etc.) to the TAC, Project Engineering and Upgrade teams and in some cases directly to the customer. As needed, training is to be provided by the Distinguished National Support Engineer to the various technical and non-technical areas on new software/product releases.

Beyond the technical leadership provided by Distinguished National Support Engineer, complex problem solving, mentorship and guidance, customer interaction, provide project leadership will also be provided.

Also, this position requires the Distinguished National Support Engineer to be up to date on latest technologies and the ability to present the technology to the business and how it can improve the identified business needs.

In addition, the Distinguished National Support Engineer will provide after-hours technical support via the On-call process for down site situations 24/7 as needed.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Advanced Troubleshooting
    • Provides skills, knowledge, and experience in solving complex issues that other areas cannot resolve.
    • Tasked with review and triaging of escalations received from TAC, presenting the issue to development, working with development until resolution.
    • Consults with TAC and Development to analyze Synapse issues that require Development action.
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship
    • Provide technical support to the Enterprise Support team and other areas of the business as needed.
    • Tasked with ownership of the mentorship process between the Enterprise Support Team members and interaction to other technical teams within the business.
    • Tasked with providing highly specialized advanced technical training to the TAC, Upgrade and Project Engineer team members and global business partners.
    • Formally establish and oversee mentorship programs for Principal and other technical support engineers.
    • Tasked with leading cross-functional technical investigations and problem-solving teams involving multiple stakeholders (Development, QA, Product Management).
  • Drives Continuous Improvement
    • Understands and routinely verify the current process are aligned within the strategic objective of the business.
    • Adheres to the Escalation Process requirements for timely escalated issues according to established procedures.
    • Provides insight and direction on the process of creating, reviewing, and publishing documentation, and publishing of Knowledge Base articles in a timely manner.
    • Lead strategic initiatives to reduce escalations and improve product quality through collaboration with R&D.
    • Actively research, evaluate, and propose new technologies or methodologies to enhance support capabilities or product offerings.
    • Define best practices and technical standards for the global support team, ensuring consistency and excellence.
    • Drive innovation within the support organization by researching and piloting new technologies (e.g., AI/ML for predictive analytics, advanced observability tools).
  • System Architecture Designs and scalability
    • Explores new technologies and provide guidance on how they can be utilized to achieve customer satisfaction and business objectives.
    • Influence product design and architecture for supportability, reliability, and diagnosability.
    • Act as a trusted advisor to senior management on critical technical decisions and future technological trends.
    • Interacts with customers on complex issues and communications directly with development and other areas of the business as required
      • As needed, manage technical issues directly with customers.
  • Cross-Functional Team Leadership
    • Participates in cross functional team across the business to provide strategical technical direction in accordance with the objective of the business.
    • Works cross-functionally with other Synapse teams/products as required and handles other duties as assigned.
    • Collaborate with peers and all other FUJIFILM teams to solve complex technical issues and develop innovative solutions.
  • Works directly with development on special projects, new software/product releases or as needed.
  • Tasked with communicating clinically related issues to development.
  • When requested, provide directions to the marketing and sales teams for technically related questions presented in Request for Proposal (RFP) received by the business to win new opportunities.
  • Operates with minimal managerial supervision, while being driven through self-motivation and driving issues to completion.
  • Engages immediately upon request from TAC on issues with high visibility customers and highly complex escalation.
  • Provide on-call assistance to TAC, PE, or UE teams for down sites after hours support as needed.
  • Maintains an expert working knowledge of current medical imaging products and related technologies.
  • Stays abreast of the latest industry/technology advances through continuous education.
  • Provides guidance to the team members based on management direction.
  • Positive customer surveys, documentation accuracy and consistency, and special project completion, and completion for all assigned training are standard expectations for all FUJI engineers.
  • Maintains a high level of success with yearly goals provided by your manager and metrics defined on a team level.
  • Working outside of normal business hours, overtime, holidays, and participation in an on-call rotation are required to cover the needs of the business.
  • Based on the need, short notice overnight travel, based on the needs of the business, to work on customer systems may be required.
  • Adheres to the Company's quality and regulatory compliance requirements, without exception, and ensures that all job duties inherent in the position description are performed in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 4 years of proficiency in holding the position of Senior Principal National Support Engineer II is preferred.
  • Minimum twelve (12) years of progressive experience as a Technical, Systems, Software or Quality Assurance Engineer in Medical IT and/or Imaging products.
  • Master (preferred) with 8 years industry experience or Bachelor’s Degree with industry experience of 10 years or comparable work experience of 12+ years of industry experience.
  • Current Leading Industry Certifications – one or more preferred, not limited to:
    • Security Certification (Security + or higher).
    • Current VCP Certification.
    • VCP certification.
    • CISCO Certification.
    • Azure certification.
    • Linux Certification.
    • Microsoft Certification.
    • Relevant professional-level cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) or advanced networking certifications (e.g., CCIE/CCNP equivalent).
  • Outstanding troubleshooting skills in a pressure situation.
  • Mastery with soft skills in high pressure situation.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Demonstrates clear and logical thinking and the ability to think outside of the box to address complex issues when required.
  • Demonstrates expertise in at least one product line offering and has a basic/intermediate understanding of at least 1 other current product.
  • Adept with storage systems and storage protocols: SMB and S3.
  • Mastery of networking architectures and demonstrates the ability to efficiently troubleshoot issues using available networking commands and Wireshark or sniffing software.
  • Expert with applicable industry related communication protocols: DICOM, HL7, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS.
  • Skilled with cloud computing concepts: AWS, Azure, etc.
  • Masters understanding of the Microsoft operating systems (Microsoft Server 2012, 2016, 2019, 2022+) utilized by the current products and system administration.
  • Skilled with Shell Scripting in BASH, PowerShell.
  • Skilled with programing languages: C#, Java, Python, HTML/XML.
  • Expertise in databases (ORACLE, Postgresql and SQL) and use of SQL Plus and SQL scripts.
  • Adept with Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Proficient in managing Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) servers or its downstream server distributions (CentOS, Oracle Linux, Scientific Linux.
  • Master level knowledge of medical informatics architecture and design (VMware and Storage Solutions).
  • Mastery knowledge of Linux Architecture and system administration
  • High level of understanding and experience in optimizing the performance, scalability, and security of enterprise-level medical informatics systems
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear strategic recommendations for business leaders.
  • Lead the development and curation of advanced knowledge bases and diagnostic playbooks

Key Performance Indicators

To maintain this position, the Distinguished National Support Engineer:

  • Maintain all currently held Industry certifications.
  • Maintain and expand the expert knowledge of their current primary product line and future releases.
  • Proven ability in driving and working issues within development until resolution.
  • Provide advanced technical knowledge for other parts of the organization including (but not limited to) International Partners, TAC, PE, and UE teams.
  • Create, review and publish applicable documentation in timely fashion.
  • Respond to escalation requests within the response times identified in the approved escalation process.
  • Conduct training to other parts of the organization via virtual meeting and/or in person training classes.

Physical requirements

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to sit up 75-100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk and listen for 75% of applicable work time.
  • This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, and/or crawling under a desk.
  • Ability to be able to lift and/or move items that weigh up to 50 pounds frequently.
  • Ability to reach above their head to work on equipment that is on a desk, on the floor, or a server rack within a datacenter.
  • Ability to type and have the manual dexterity to manipulate hand tools such as screwdrivers, pliers, wrenches, etc.

Salary and Benefits

Within Insurance & Investments, the CISO leads enterprise cybersecurity, information security governance, cyber risk management, security architecture, incident response, regulatory compliance, identity and access management, third-party security, and business continuity/cyber resilience.

Job Title: Customer Acquisition Specialist

Location: Caribbean Region

Job Level: Full-Time | Fully Remote (2-year renewable contract)

Job Summary

The Customer Acquisition Specialist at The Hive Careers is responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new clients, expand the company's customer base, and strengthen client relationships through proactive outreach. This role works closely with the marketing and sales teams to generate leads, optimize conversion funnels, support client outreach initiatives, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new customers.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation: Identify and engage potential customers through various channels, including digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, networking events, and direct outreach.

Client Outreach: Conduct proactive outreach to prospective clients through email, phone calls, social platforms, and other communication channels to build relationships, introduce services, and convert leads into customers.

Marketing Funnel Optimization: Analyze and improve the customer journey from awareness to conversion, ensuring efficient processes that maximize acquisition rates.

Data Analysis: Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer acquisition and outreach efforts, providing regular reports and insights to guide strategic decisions.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

Customer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term relationships.

Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify new growth opportunities.

Budget Management: Manage acquisition budgets effectively, ensuring resources are allocated strategically to meet targets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Proven experience in customer acquisition, client outreach, sales, or marketing roles
  • At least 3-5 years experience in B2B client acquisition

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency in CRM software and marketing tools
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Self-motivated with a results-oriented approach
  • Strong relationship-building and client engagement skill
